data.name: Lariyah
data.gender_notes: Lariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'L-R-Y', meaning 'to be light' or 'to be radiant'. This name is mentioned in a Hadith where the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said that a girl born on a Monday is named Lariyah. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Islamic culture. The name Lariyah carries the meaning “Light, Bright, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light in the world, shining with God's love and guidance.
data.etymology: Lariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Bright, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lariyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: لاريّة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لاريّة اسمٌ مِصرى يُعتَقَد أَنَّهُ يُشيرُ إِلَى المَولودَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ، وَهُوَ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي تُشيرُ إِلَى السَنَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ. وَقَدْ يُشيرُ الْأَصْلُ إِلَى السَنَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ، وَمِنَ الصِفاتِ الَّتِي تُشيرُ إِلَى المَولودَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ. وَقَدْ ذُكِرَ في الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ أَنَّهُ يُشيرُ إِلَى السَنَةِ الَّتِي يَنَالُها الرَجُلُ بَعْدَ إِنجابِ المَولودِ. وَكَمِ منَ الرِجَالِ يَختارونَ لِأَحفادِهِمُ أَن يُسمَوّوا بِاسْمِ لاريّة لِأَنَّهُ يُشيرُ إِلَى السَنَةِ الَّتِي يَنَالُها الرَجُلُ بَعْدَ إِنجابِ المَولودِ. وَحَسَبَ الْأَصْلِ، فَاللاريّةُ هِيَ السَنَةُ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ، وَإِلَيهِ يَنَالُها الرَجُلُ بَعْدَ إِنجابِ المَولودِ. وَهَذَا الْأَسْمُ بِأَسْماءِ السَنَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ، وَمِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي تُشيرُ إِلَى المَولودَةِ الَّتِي تَلِي بَعدَ الرَجُلِ.

in_english.name: Lariyah
in_english.meaning: a female given name meaning 'born after a man' with roots in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Lariyah is a female given name that originates from Arabic and means 'born after a man'. The name is derived from the Arabic word 'lari', which means 'to be born after' or 'to follow'. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the concept of 'lari', which refers to the time period between the birth of a child and the death of the father. The name is often given to girls born after a man has died, as a way of honoring the memory of the father. In Arabic, the name is written as لاريّة (Lāriyah), and it is pronounced as LAH-ree-yah. The name has been used in various cultures, including Arabic, Turkish, and Urdu-speaking communities.
